newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen's prime minister says work on border dispute between Yemen and Saudi Arabia proceeding slowly.
- Turkey announces an end to its army's incursion into northern Iraq.
- A German oil firm to invest $12 million in an oil project in Yemen.
- United Arab Emirates, Germany sign a deal to protect and encourage investments between them.
- Jordanian prime minister denies arrest of a suspect in connection with the al-Khobar bombing in Saudi Arabia.
- U.S. and French presidents discuss new ideas to move forwards the stalled Middle East peace process.
- Five banks to sign on Monday a $500 million loan with Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - East.
- United Nations discusses with Iraqi and Syrian officials setting up supervision centres on the recently-opened borders between Iraq and Syria.
